title: Albums, Decca autobiography and a closing request
summary: He discusses albums not on sale locally, the Decca life-story album, and what they will play, including songs from Satchmo Plays Fats.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Haven't you any plans for issuing an album?
Well, I just made several albums. They are out yet? Yeah, they're not over here. They don't have nothing I made with Ella Fitzgerald.
Yes, that one, but the life story, like the Crosby life story.

Well, I made that, too, for the Decca. That's not out. It's not out here. Not out here. Autobiography, all from the beginning of the tunes I played in England and everywhere, from the old 78s up to the modern-day record. Yeah, it costs $25 in the States. Quick one, Mr. Wayne.
Blue turning gray. Your wife's favorite number, I believe.
Are we going to hear it here?

Well, we'll play it. Good. We'll play what we can get together on. Because some of them was on that album, Sashmo plays Fats. Yeah. And that's why we can do that, because they was on there. Look forward to that. Yeah.
